lastCompletedStory.title: Clear implement-blocked marker on the complete terminal (loop.ts + host.ts)

nextStoryContext: Added removeImplementBlockedMarkerFn (loop.ts + host.ts), gated on status === 'complete' && lastIssueNumber !== undefined, inside the existing finishTerminal seam right after the existing writeImplementBlockedMarkerFn 'blocked' block. loop.ts stays filesystem/path-free (no fs/path import added); host.ts wires it to removeImplementBlockedMarker(implementBlockedMarkerPath), the same path the writer uses. advanceBlockedMarker, the marker schema, sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker, and clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue were NOT touched, per AC5. file-size-budget.json ceilings for src/supervisor/loop.ts (2391->2419) and src/supervisor/host.ts (1108->1119) were raised with a dated _ref note for this story.
